{{Quote|Master Yoda may be small and old and shriveled up like an evil green potato, but he is my guest, and I would prefer you not hit him with a broom unless I particularly desire it.|[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]|<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>}}
A '''potato''' was an edible starchy tuber. An oddly-shaped brown object, its appearance was similar to that of the [[Planet/Legends|planetoid]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].

Types of potato included Corellian potatoes, which were served at the [[Vor-cal Feast]] prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

[[Mounder potato rice]] was a potato product.

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
Potatoes were known to make [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] sick, as was the case with [[Etro Edthatt]].
{{Noncanonend}}

==Behind the scenes==
During the filming of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], a potato was used as an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]].
